facts.fact: Digital Business Africa reports that Adamou Iro, president of Niger's Haute Autorité de Protection des Données à caractère personnel (HAPDP), signed the AES data-protection roadmap with Burkina Faso's CIL and Mali's APDP on 18 November 2025 in Ouagadougou.
